name: check-characteristics-mint-unused-fixture
_why: Planted for @SCN-CHR-004's @integration arm — THE MINT THAT LICENSES NOTHING. `flakiness` is minted with the same whole sentence of reason the reasoned fixture states, and no registry or threshold entry of this target names the word any more: the check it was minted for has gone. So the entry reds nothing by construction and sits on as standing permission for the next characteristic that happens to match it — the fault @SCN-VOC-017 closes for the exempt list, reached here by the same route. `lint:complexity` beside it is a roster word needing no mint, so the red can only have come from the mint being stale.

mintedCharacteristics.flakiness: This target reruns its suite to find order-dependent tests, and no roster word names the property that check asserts.
